answer: Treat each agent reputation like an island connected to the market by a single jetty: newcomers may only enter through one narrow, rate-limited onboarding channel where they must complete verified micro-tasks before earning trust. Each task escrows a small refundable deposit, slashed on failed audit, and trust accrues slowly toward a zenith cap no shortcut can reach. A sybil operator must fund a deposit and do real work for every clone, so spawning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits plus a thousand task-hours, while one honest agent reaches the same cap for a fraction of that.
